classification: Exploratory follow-up specified after inspecting IV-G at 0.79 and the alternating results. The fixed-weight 0.80 outcomes were not used to choose the analysis. The 40 evaluation seeds were previously used for related comparisons.
endpoint_rule: Average the two directions within each seed. All five paired 95% intervals must lie within their margins to describe the corresponding comparison as matched. Report every result regardless of the gate.
primary: Difference between the alternating and within-batch common-scale pattern effects at the same favored weight 0.80. For each seed and direction: contrast = acquisition response minus update-route response; pattern effect = own contrast minus exchanged contrast; difference = alternating pattern effect minus within-batch pattern effect. Use each pair's geometric mean initial multiplier in both of its exchange conditions, exactly as in the original comparison.
secondary: All five initial readout differences for acquisition vs mixed and alternating vs mixed; unscaled inherited, m/v-exchanged and reset route contrasts; retained-pattern and exchanged-pattern contrasts at common scale. Record per-direction values, endpoint switch counts at update 10, and the two mixed encoder cancellation fractions. The original 0.79 pilot-selected condition stays separate.
analysis_unit: 40 paired seed averages. Two directions per seed. Percentile intervals, resampling whole seeds for every paired difference.
stop: All 40 fixed seeds once, both directions. No replacements or recalibration if a tolerance fails. Rebuild the alternating reference on the original checkpoints and check against the archived per-seed table.
authorization: Additional equal-weight control requested after the calibrated comparison had been inspected. Local analysis plan recorded before the new fixed-weight run.
